description:
The same list of medicines for another place — called by the FineRx card itself.

    ``slugs`` with their packages in parallel lists (an empty string or 0 = not
    set). ``where`` is the place as typed in the card: used for this one
    request, never stored. Not for the model.

forms.description: Parallel to slugs: the dosage form for each medicine (an empty string means not set).
forms.title: Forms

locale.description: A language code for the answer (the host's own is used when left out).
locale.title: Locale

quantities.description: Parallel to slugs: the quantity for each medicine (0 means not set).
quantities.title: Quantities

slugs.description: The medicines' slugs, with their packages in the parallel strengths, forms and quantities lists.
slugs.title: Slugs

strengths.description: Parallel to slugs: the strength for each medicine (an empty string means not set).
strengths.title: Strengths

where.description: The place as typed in the card (a ZIP, a city or an address); used for this one request, never stored.
where.title: Where

zip.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code to locate prices and stores near; pass it only when the person gave one.
zip.title: Zip

name: ui_basket
